verdict.rationale: AMD's product page publishes 288GB HBM3E memory and 8TB/s bandwidth for the MI355X, and Chips and Cheese independently confirms 288 GB at 8 TB/s. Capacity, memory type and bandwidth are well covered, but the story asks for the full spec, and bus width appears nowhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: memory bus width (and any detailed per-stack or interface spec sheet) for this exact part.
